m(x) := \max_i x_i, \quad 
f(x) := \left[ e^{x_1 - m(x)} \ \ldots \ e^{x_B - m(x)} \right], \quad
\ell(x) := \sum_i f(x)_i, \quad
\mathrm{softmax}(x) := \frac{f(x)}{\ell(x)}.

m(x) = m\!\left( \left[ x^{(1)} \ x^{(2)} \right] \right)
= \max\left( m(x^{(1)}), m(x^{(2)}) \right), \quad
f(x) = \left[ e^{m(x^{(1)}) - m(x)} f(x^{(1)}) \quad e^{m(x^{(2)}) - m(x)} f(x^{(2)}) \right]

\ell(x) = \ell\!\left( \left[ x^{(1)} \ x^{(2)} \right] \right)
= e^{m(x^{(1)}) - m(x)} \ell(x^{(1)}) 
+ e^{m(x^{(2)}) - m(x)} \ell(x^{(2)}), \quad
\mathrm{softmax}(x) = \frac{f(x)}{\ell(x)}

\begin{aligned}
m^{(1)} &= \operatorname{rowmax}\!\left(S^{(1)}\right)\in\mathbb{R}^{B_r},\\
\ell^{(1)} &= \operatorname{rowsum}\!\left(e^{S^{(1)}-m^{(1)}}\right)\in\mathbb{R}^{B_r},\\
\widetilde{P}^{(1)} &= \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\ell^{(1)}\right)^{-1}e^{S^{(1)}-m^{(1)}}\in\mathbb{R}^{B_r\times B_c},\\
O^{(1)} &= \widetilde{P}^{(1)}V^{(1)}=\operatorname{diag}\!\left(\ell^{(1)}\right)^{-1}e^{S^{(1)}-m^{(1)}}V^{(1)}\in\mathbb{R}^{B_r\times d},\\
m^{(2)} &= \max\!\left(m^{(1)},\operatorname{rowmax}\!\left(S^{(2)}\right)\right)=m,\\
\ell^{(2)} &= e^{m^{(1)}-m^{(2)}}\ell^{(1)}+\operatorname{rowsum}\!\left(e^{S^{(2)}-m^{(2)}}\right)=\operatorname{rowsum}\!\left(e^{S^{(1)}-m}\right)+\operatorname{rowsum}\!\left(e^{S^{(2)}-m}\right)=\ell,\\
\widetilde{P}^{(2)} &= \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\ell^{(2)}\right)^{-1}e^{S^{(2)}-m^{(2)}}\in\mathbb{R}^{B_r\times B_c},\\
O^{(2)} &= \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac{\ell^{(1)}}{\ell^{(2)}}\right)e^{m^{(1)}-m^{(2)}}O^{(1)}+\widetilde{P}^{(2)}V^{(2)}=\operatorname{diag}\!\left(\ell^{(2)}\right)^{-1}e^{S^{(1)}-m}V^{(1)}+\operatorname{diag}\!\left(\ell^{(2)}\right)^{-1}e^{S^{(2)}-m}V^{(2)}=O.
\end{aligned}
